additional_info.subject: RE: ID0374955-DC/Si-D/NZ-[X9PrfQ] AC Charging Issue CRM:00798001170
additional_info.body:
Hello Liz,
Today our technician was on site and performed was fault finding around the AC charging port.
On arrival, he noted that the AC port was in use and after some follow up, found out that the port was sometimes working and other times not.
He spoke to one of the staff members there and they said, sometimes it doesnt work, so they would try several times to unplug and replug and if it still doesnt work, they would leave it for ~30 minutes and come back and then it is operational again.
All the wiring around the AC contactor used within the charger were checked and found in good state.
As some wiring was removed and replugged, we request that the AC charging use be monitored for operation for the next week.
If it is still not resolved, we will aim to arrange the required replacement parts.
With Kind Regards,
Ferdinand Reisch
Siemens Ltd.
Application Service Engineer
Email: ferdinand.reisch@siemens.com
www.siemens.com.au/emobility
